newsitem.title: IRAN: Refugees say Iraq-backed Kurds executed 25 rivals.
newsitem.headline: Refugees say Iraq-backed Kurds executed 25 rivals.

text.p: Kurdish refugees on Thursday accused an Iraq-backed Kurd faction of executing 25 fighters of a rival group in violation of an amnesty, the Iranian news agency IRNA said.

It quoted Kurdish refugees arriving at the Iranian border crossing of Bashmaq as saying that Kurdistan Democratic Party (KDP) forces executed the guerrillas of the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan (PUK) in the nearby Iraqi town of Penjwin on Tuesday.
The Baghdad-backed KDP had issued an amnesty on Tuesday for all members of the rival PUK which it defeated in a nine-day drive through northern Iraq.
There was no independent confirmation of the report.
Iran said on Wednesday it was sheltering 39,000 refugees who fled from KDP forces.
